text: Host effort deviation for this whole run: every agent stage is dispatched as a fresh Claude Code harness subagent with no inherited conversation, whose reasoning effort is inherited from the driver session. The harness exposes no per-dispatch effort control and no pinned-effort subagent definition (tpt-high, tpt-xhigh, tpt-max) is loaded in this session, so a stage's declared EFFORT cannot be enforced: stages run at the driver session's effort whatever they declare. The subagent model is inherited from the driver session, claude-opus-5-5[1m]. Each worker is handed the packet by its exact path and SHA-256 and reads it in full; the driver adds only the result path, a worker-owned scratch directory and the checkout path. Packet bytes, workflow digest and declared efforts are unchanged.
